sealed_stage_rule: Never execute or dispatch a sealed-stage rerun. Frozen state may be checked by fingerprint/lock only.
stable_rule: Never mutate tinysnow-tool-only from the command bridge.
command_scope_rule: A command may only execute operations explicitly listed in allowed_operations and not listed in forbidden_operations.
owner_approval_rule: Any owner-approval-required operation is blocked unless owner_approval=true and a later owner-authorized execution path explicitly handles it. This dry-run bridge never performs such operations.
